_comment: The six places the yey.boats stack decides what an autopilot command may be (#28 step 1). Read from source on 2026-11-10; refs are the commits read. Angles: SignalK carries radians; adjustHeading is the one path in degrees (signalk-autopilot / spec-16 convention). 'via_connector' says whether a command from that implementation can reach a boat through this connector. test/steering-policy.test.js checks lib/steering-policy.js against this table: every sample in 'emits' with via_connector=true must be accepted, every 'must_refuse' refused.

implementations.role: ESP32 display: PUTs straight to the boat's own SignalK over the LAN

paths.notes: autopilot.cpp mode_name: standby|auto|wind|pretrack|track; screen_autopilot.cpp also sends route. Engage modes gated by Permissions.allow_engage (off by default), standby by allow_standby (on).

paths.clamp: adjust_heading_deg refuses |delta|>90 (InvalidPayload); tack/gybe clamp_maneuver caps the computed turn to +-90 and a second tap finishes it
paths.notes: gated by Permissions.allow_heading_adjust
knob_menu wrap_2pi into [0,2pi); screen_autopilot put_heading %.4f
alarm silence; not an autopilot path
midl_render: action kind command|put with a dotted target is PUT as-is with action.value or true (e.g. demo doc 'steering.autopilot.tack')

implementations.rate: none (one PUT per tap, net worker queue)

implementations.role: Mini App buttons + chat autopilot_* tools; sends op put to this connector for a connector boat

paths.notes: _MODES; lower-cased, quotes stripped; anything else refused bad_value

paths.clamp: an explicit step past 150 is REFUSED (bad_value); only the computed tack/gybe turn is clamped to +-150 (_clamp) before it is sent; chat autopilot_adjust takes radians and converts
paths.notes: also the device dialect adjustHeading.plusN/minusN, sent as adjustHeading=N
0 <= v <= 2pi INCLUSIVE; outside refused, never wrapped
resolve_action fallback: any target starting steering.autopilot. is PUT as-is with value or true (the trigger convention)

implementations.rate: 12 confirmed actions/min per user (rate_ok); boat_rpc 30 requests/min per boat

request.deadline_ms: always sent: wall clock now + timeout (<= 5 s)

other: needs an owner grant (two-channel code) and, for a connector boat, the on-boat switch

implementations.role: this plugin before #28: the last hop, executes app.putSelfPath

paths.notes: any boolean, finite number or string <= 32 chars
no range
no range
any action name

request.deadline_ms: optional; a put without one is never stale
request.replay: in-memory, last 256 ids, lost on restart

implementations.role: simulator-only SignalK PUT handler; re-emits steering.autopilot.command deltas

paths.notes: track/pretrack mapped to route; quotes stripped; else 400
any finite number or numeric string; no range; converted to radians
any finite number or numeric string; no range
any value; cycles standby->auto->wind->route

implementations.role: former display-manager PUT bridge, moved to the simulator plugin

paths.notes: no enum; track/pretrack mapped to route
Number(value)||0: garbage became a 0 turn
Number(value)||0: garbage became heading 0
set_heading/adjust values in radians (converted to degrees); modes standby|auto|wind|route; heading wrapped mod 360; unknown actions ignored

implementations.rate: none; nonce dedupe, last 256-512 in memory

differences: adjustHeading step: firmware +-90 (refuse), cloud +-150 (refuse explicit, clamp computed tack/gybe), sim and connector-0.4 unbounded.
headingTrue: firmware [0,2pi), cloud [0,2pi] inclusive, sim/bridge/connector-0.4 unbounded.
state vocabulary: cloud auto|wind|route|standby; firmware adds track|pretrack; sim maps track/pretrack to route; connector-0.4 any short string.
actions: connector-0.4 any single segment; the only action names any implementation sends or handles are adjustHeading, tack, advanceMode.
windAngleApparent: allowlisted by connector-0.4 only; no implementation sends it.
rate: cloud 12/min per user, connector 12/min per boat, firmware/sim none.

must_refuse.why: 2pi: the policy range is [0,2pi); the cloud allows 2pi inclusive (see differences)
no implementation handles it; connector-0.4 accepted any action
firmware MIDL demo target; not an autopilot PUT path
